zh.title: 波特航空班機因幼童站立返門 延誤超過宵禁遭取消
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波特航空（Porter Airlines）一班深夜航班因機組人員無法成功安頓一名在座位上站立的幼童，導致飛機被迫返回登機門。該班航班隨後因作業延誤時間超過機場宵禁規定而宣告取消，造成機上所有人員被迫滯留過夜。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，波特航空（Porter Airlines）一班深夜營運的航班於地面階段發生客艙處置狀況。事發時機組人員無法順利安頓並固定一名在座椅上站立的幼童，基於客艙安全無法完成起飛前準備，該班飛機隨後決定返回登機門。
飛機返回登機門處理該起事件時，造成航班起飛時間嚴重遞延。由於該航班過後延誤時間過長，已不幸超越了該機場規定的夜間宵禁限制，使得該班機無法在宵禁時間內順利離站起飛。
在評估相關宵禁限制後，航空公司最終決定將該趟航班予以取消。該起取消事件導致機上全數乘客無法按原定計畫出行，所有乘客被迫滯留在機場過夜。

en.title: Porter Airlines Cancels Flight After Toddler Stands in Seat and Delays It Past Curfew
en.summary: According to a report from Simple Flying, a late-night Porter Airlines flight was forced to return to the airport gate before departure after the cabin crew was unable to properly secure a young toddler standing on a seat. As a direct result of the delay caused by the seat incident, the departure missed its scheduled window and pushed past the local airport's overnight curfew rules, forcing the airline to cancel the flight and leaving all onboard passengers stranded overnight.
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, a late-night Porter Airlines flight returned to the airport gate before departure. The return occurred after cabin crew members were unable to secure a standing toddler in their seat during pre-flight preparations.

The operational delay associated with resolving the cabin issue pushed the flight past the airport's enforced overnight curfew threshold. Consequently, the aircraft was prevented from taking off within the allowable operational timeframe.
Due to the curfew restriction, Porter Airlines ultimately canceled the flight entirely. The cancellation left all passengers stranded at the airport overnight.
